podcast.title: Lending Van to Blink-182
podcast.body: In their early days, the band Unwritten Law provided crucial support to Blink-182 by lending them their van for out-of-town gigs when Blink could not afford their own transportation. "The band unwritten law lent Blink their van for out of town gigs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall and Rise of Blink 182 Part 1

podcast.title: Mid-90s Attention
podcast.body: Unwritten Law gained attention during the mid-1990s punk rock revival, performing "okay" in terms of record sales, though not reaching the massive numbers of the era's biggest bands. "Other punk bands to get attention during the middle 90s included Unwritten Law."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Success Following The Offspring
podcast.body: This band was discovered by fans due to The Offspring's significant success in late 1994, marking the beginning of Skate Punk's "glory years." "And this led to fans discovering bands like Goldfinger, Lagwagon, Face to Face, MXPX, and Unwritten Law."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
